title: Sasha & Candy Learn About Sri Lanka

lines.say: Hi friends! I'm Sasha, and this is my fluffy cat, Candy.
Today, we're flying across the ocean to a sunny island shaped like a teardrop. Sri Lanka!
Sri Lanka sits in the warm Indian Ocean, just below India.
About twenty-two million people live here, and they greet you with a big smile and say, Ah-yoo-boh-wun!
lines.cap: About twenty-two million people live here, and they greet you with a big smile and say, Ayubowan!

lines.say: That means, may you live a long life.
Whoa! This giant rock is See-gi-ri-ya, the Lion Rock.
lines.cap: Whoa! This giant rock is Sigiriya, the Lion Rock.

lines.say: Fifteen hundred years ago, a king built his palace right on the top, almost two hundred metres up in the sky!
Next, a little blue train carries us into the misty green hills.
These are tea gardens. The leaves picked here fill teacups all around the world.
Sri Lanka is full of amazing animals. Gentle elephants, dancing peacocks,
and even leopards. Don't worry, Candy, they're just your big cousins!
And out in the deep blue sea swims the biggest animal on Earth, the blue whale.
On the golden beaches, fishermen balance on tall wooden stilts, and baby sea turtles scurry to the waves.
When night falls in the city of Kandy, the Peh-ra-heh-ra festival begins.
lines.cap: When night falls in the city of Kandy, the Perahera festival begins.

lines.say: Drummers, dancers, and elephants dressed in sparkling lights parade through the streets.
All this exploring makes us hungry! Let's try rice and curry, crispy bowl-shaped pancakes called hoppers, and sweet king coconut water.
Mmm! And real cinnamon comes from right here, too.
Sri Lanka is a small island with a very big heart.
Thank you for exploring with us. Or, as we say here, Bo-ho-ma stoo-thee!
lines.cap: Thank you for exploring with us. Or, as we say here, Bohoma sthuthi!

lines.say: See you on our next adventure. Bye bye!
